verdict.rationale: A government tax and licensing portal like My DOR could plausibly offer a natural-language assistant or chatbot, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only click-through forms and wizards, typed filtering of jurisdiction names, and an automated phone line, none of which is natural-language operation of the product. Probes found no llms.txt, markdown docs or OpenAPI spec, and the transactional portal sits behind a login wall.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
